introduction_markdown:
**Cameroon General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Pure Mathematics With Statistics, Paper 3 (0770/3), ADVANCED LEVEL, June 2020. Time allowed: THREE HOURS.**

Full marks may be obtained for answers to ALL questions. Mathematical formulae and tables produced by the GCE Board are allowed. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving the answer at each stage. Electronic calculators are allowed. Start each question on a fresh page.
enonce_intro_markdown:
The masses of oranges from an orchard are normally distributed with mean $\mu$ and standard deviation $\sigma$. 10% of the oranges from this orchard have masses less than 25 grammes and 5% have masses greater than 85 grammes.

Calculate, to 4 decimal places, the values of the mean, the standard deviation and the variance of the masses of oranges.
incertitudes: Question 4 : les valeurs à 4 décimales dépendent des points critiques utilisés. Le corrigé emploie ceux de la table du Board (table des points de pourcentage de la loi normale) : $z = 1.2816$ pour 10 % et $z = 1.6449$ pour 5 %, d'où $\mu = 51.2758$, $\sigma = 20.5023$, $\sigma^2 = 420.3446$. Avec les valeurs exactes ($1.281552$ et $1.644854$) on obtiendrait $51.2756$, $20.5030$ et $420.3718$ ; avec des valeurs de table à 2 ou 3 décimales (1.28 ou 1.282 et 1.645), $\mu \approx 51.26$ à $51.28$.
Question 4 : le sujet n'imprime que le total (13 marks) pour une seule question ; elle est transcrite en une seule partie `1`.

questions.enonce_markdown: Calculate, to 4 decimal places, the values of the mean, the standard deviation and the variance of the masses of oranges.
questions.corrige_markdown:
**Model.** Let $X$ be the mass of an orange (in grammes), $X \sim N(\mu, \sigma^2)$, and $Z = \dfrac{X - \mu}{\sigma} \sim N(0, 1)$.

**Equation from 10 %.** $P(X < 25) = 0.10$, so $P\left(Z < \dfrac{25 - \mu}{\sigma}\right) = 0.10$. The point below which 10 % of the standard normal lies is negative: by symmetry $P(Z < -1.2816) = 0.10$ (table value, since $\Phi(1.2816) = 0.90$). Hence

$$
\frac{25 - \mu}{\sigma} = -1.2816 \quad\Longrightarrow\quad \mu - 1.2816\,\sigma = 25 \tag{1}
$$

**Equation from 5 %.** $P(X > 85) = 0.05$, so $P\left(Z < \dfrac{85 - \mu}{\sigma}\right) = 0.95$, and the table gives $\Phi(1.6449) = 0.95$. Hence

$$
\frac{85 - \mu}{\sigma} = 1.6449 \quad\Longrightarrow\quad \mu + 1.6449\,\sigma = 85 \tag{2}
$$

**Solve.** Subtracting (1) from (2): $(1.6449 + 1.2816)\,\sigma = 85 - 25$, that is $2.9265\,\sigma = 60$.

$$\sigma = \frac{60}{2.9265} = 20.5023\ldots$$

Substituting in (1): $\mu = 25 + 1.2816 \times 20.5023 = 25 + 26.2758 = 51.2758$.

$$\sigma^2 = \left(\frac{60}{2.9265}\right)^2 = 420.3446\ldots$$

**Check:** $51.2758 + 1.6449 \times 20.5023 = 51.2758 + 33.7242 = 85.0000$. $\checkmark$

**Mean $\mu \approx 51.2758$ g; standard deviation $\sigma \approx 20.5023$ g; variance $\sigma^2 \approx 420.3446$ g$^2$.**
